children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Expose game ports intentionally, restrict source networks, and automate recurring maintenance with schedules and health-aware recovery.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Public exposure is a security boundary. Review service type, ports, annotations, DNS, and CIDRs together.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Select ClusterIP, NodePort, or LoadBalancer based on where players connect and who controls the network edge. When you have no public IP or no control over the network edge, layer a relay tunnel over the Service.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Use ClusterIP for internal-only servers and proxies.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Use stable named ports and reserve NodePorts to avoid collisions.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Attach provider annotations and DNS only when the controller supports them.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Layer relay tunnels (frp, Tailscale, playit) over the Service when lacking public IP or LoadBalancer.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Treat every port override and CIDR allow-list as part of the server’s documented interface.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Expose only required TCP or UDP ports; v0.4.0 lets kubelet probes reach only those ports.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Validate hostname, external address, and firewall path end to end.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Keep management interfaces private even when game ports are public.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Schedules can run backups and maintenance while probes and restart policy handle unexpected failures.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Validate cron timezone, target server, destination, and retention

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Announce maintenance and save before a planned restart

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Confirm the job, resulting backup, and audit entry completed
